name: reactemaileditor
description: React Email Editor based on Unlayer's wrapper component available at https://github.com/unlayer/react-email-editor
author: Stoneworx
comment_mendix10: Aligned to Mendix 10.24 (React 18), matching the app this widget ships in.
See custom/react-email-editor/README.md for the full compatibility matrix;
the same five constraints apply to both widgets. In short: the toolchain
major and React must match the target Studio Pro, rollup must be pinned so
the plugin peers do not hoist v4 over the v3 the config expects, and react
must not appear in dependencies or the toolchain prompts to migrate and
pretty-format is pinned for npm test only: @testing-library/dom@8 hoists
27.x, which rejects the maxWidth option jest-matcher-utils passes it, so a
failing assertion reports that error instead of its diff.
